10278.html:
10278 mr̥tá 'dead' RV., n. 'death' MBh., °aka- n. KātyŚr.com. [Pp. of mriyátē and máratē. — √mr̥]
    Pa. mata- 'dead', Aś.shah. muṭa-, kāl. maṭa-, gir. mata-, NiDoc. mr̥da (= *mrida), mata, mutaṁti, Dhp. muda-, Pk. mada-, maya-, mua-, maḍa-, mayaga-, Gy. eur. mulo, arm. mul- 'to die', pal. mră 'he died', Ḍ. moya, Ash. mᵊṛə, f. məṛí 'died', Wg. mə̄ř 'died', mṛōstä, mō̃st 'dead', Kt. mŕa 'died', Pr. moksum 'I am dead'; Tir. muṛa 'died', Paš.gul. muṛī 'dead', chil. lik, f. lič 'died', ar. blīk, Woṭ. muṛ, pl. miṛ, Gaw. mirō; Kho. birdu 'dead' (< older *brid- ? — cf. absol. birti < *mr̥tvī́); Tor. mū, f. muī 'died', Phal. muṛo; Sh. mū̃ṷ, f. mũyi 'dead', (Lor.) mūo 'he died'; K. mū-motᵘ 'dead', kash. mūdmut, S. muo, mo, L. mōeā, mult. awāṇ. mōā, P. moā, moeā, WPah.bhiḍ. mũ n. sg., mũā̃ pl., jaun. muwā, Ku. muo, A. marā (or from pres. st.), B. maṛā; Bhoj. muwal 'to die'; OAw. muā, f. muī 'dead'; H. muā 'dead', mūnā 'to die' (chūī-mūī f. 'the sensitive plant Mimosa pudica'), caus. muwānā 'to kill'; OG. mūu 'dead', G. muvũ 'dead, to die', moi f. 'term of abuse for a woman'; Si. maḷa 'dead'; — Pk. muala-, mūillaya-, maïlla-, f. °liyā- 'dead', OB. maïla, Mth. mail, M. melā; Ko. mello 'died'. — Ext. -kk-: P. H. maṛak m. 'plague', Or. maṛaka (cf. parallel formation from mará-).
    mr̥taka-; mr̥tamātr̥kā-, mr̥távatsā-, *mr̥tāpatya-; amŕ̥ta-.
    Addenda: mr̥tá-: WPah.kṭg. muɔ (kc. mɔro) 'died' pret. of mɔrnõ < máratē; — Garh. muyāli 'property inherited through death of kinsman' (+?).

10383.html:
10383 mriyátē 'dies' RV., mriyati MBh. [√mr̥]
    Pa. mīyati, miyyati, pres. part. miyyamāna-, (-īya- for -iya- after type nīyati, jīyati, &c. P. Tedesco Language 20, 221), NiDoc. mr̥yati (= mri°?), Pk. mijjaï, Ash. mŕem 1 sg. pres., Wg. mriyam, Kt. mŕētom, Pr. -mə-, -mō-, Dm. bri-num 1 sg. pres. (pret. naṣṭā < naṣṭá-), Paš.lauṛ. nir. dar. weg. le-, leēm 1 sg. pres., ar. bli-, Shum. līam 'I shall die', Gaw. mi- (mimān 3 sg. pres. < mriyámāṇa-), Kho. brik, brium 1 sg. fut., obristai 3 sg. pret., Sh.gil. miróĭki̯, mirī́a̯m 1 sg., koh. gur. mĭryōnṷ, Si. miyanavā. — See mr̥tá-, máratē, māráyati.
    Addenda: mriyátē: Kho. bri- 'to die' (pres. 1 sg. briyúman < mriyamāṇa-), pres.part. briyan < *mriyant-); Md. miya danī 'dies', mījje 'died'.

5941.html:
5941 tŕ̥ṣṇā f. 'thirst' RV., 'desire' R. [√tr̥ṣ]
    Pa. taṇhā- f. 'thirst, desire', tasiṇā- f. 'craving', KharI. taṣ̄a, Dhp. taṣ̄a, tasiṇa, Pk. taṇhā-, tiṇhā-; Ash. tenī́k 'thirsty', Niṅg. u-tuník, Kho. thruṣni; M. tānh, tahān f. 'thirst', Ko. tāna f., Si. taṇa.
    tr̥ṣṇaka-; *āpastr̥ṣṇa-, *uttr̥ṣṇā-, nistr̥ṣṇa-; mr̥gatr̥ṣṇi-.
